alerts.description:

Flood Warning for the following rivers in Texas...

Brazoria Counties.

forecast.

* WHERE...San Bernard River near Boling.

* WHEN...Until Thursday afternoon.

from gage. Minor backwater flooding up Peach Creek in Wharton
